result.stdout:
Description:
  Import NativeAOT MSTAT, scan DGML, map XML, and binary data into SQLite.

Usage:
  sizospy import [options]

Options:
  --mstat <mstat> (REQUIRED)    Required NativeAOT .mstat managed assembly.
  --dgml <dgml>                 NativeAOT scan DGML. Defaults to an adjacent <name>.scan.dgml.xml file.
  --map <map>                   NativeAOT XML object map. Defaults to an adjacent <name>.map.xml file.
  --binary <binary>             Final native binary. Defaults to one unambiguous adjacent binary with the MSTAT name.
  --output <output> (REQUIRED)  SQLite database to create.
  --force                       Replace an existing output database.
  -?, -h, --help                Show help and usage information

Description:
  Query a Sizospy SQLite database or generate an offline web report.

Usage:
  sizospy report [command] [options]

Options:
  -d, --database <database> (REQUIRED)  Sizospy SQLite database.
  -?, -h, --help                        Show help and usage information

Commands:
  summary     Show import coverage, graph availability, and size totals.
  members     Find and rank imported artifacts and logical members.
  dominators  Show the highest-retained dominators.
  web         Generate a self-contained offline HTML report.

Description:
  Find and rank imported artifacts and logical members.

Usage:
  sizospy report members [options]

Options:
  --name <name>                         Case-insensitive name substring.
  --kind <kind>                         Exact artifact kind.
  --assembly <assembly>                 Exact owning assembly.
  --namespace <namespace>               Exact owning namespace.
  --limit <limit>                       Maximum rows (1-100000). [default: 50]
  --sort <Leverage|Name|Retained|Self>  Sort by self, retained, leverage, or name. [default: Self]
  --format <Csv|Json|Table>             Output format: table, json, or csv. [default: Table]
  --output <output>                     Write output to a file instead of stdout.
  -?, -h, --help                        Show help and usage information
